coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Counting 18 atomic ground-truth items, the output matches 6 at a semantic level: fp16, matched seeds/configurations, chunk size 512, no lookup, mean representation, and accuracy-based measurement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The reference backbone and window are Llama-3-8B/8K rather than Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2/4K. It uses 64 selected units and 32K context instead of 96 and 12K, omits the specified GPUs and 128 initial tokens, and misses the four-token representation per 128-token unit. It does not specify the encoding-plus-decoding versus decoding-only lookup comparison or the required Retrieve.KV, Math.F, and QA datasets. It incorrectly substitutes convolution as InfLLM's default representation and introduces many unrelated factors and metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the benefits of full memory lookup, the near-collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or the advantage of representative tokens over mean representations.
